trap.label: verbo de relato
trap.wrong: Wittgenstein says that language is a game and abandons the theory.
trap.right: Wittgenstein contends that language is a game and abandons the theory.
trap.why: Português usa “diz” em tudo; em inglês o verbo (contends, suggests, abandons) mostra a postura do autor.

fix.right: According to Wittgenstein, meaning is use.

fix.wrong: He contend that meaning is use.
fix.right: He contends that meaning is use.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com contends: “W argues strongly that meaning is use.”
rewrite.answer: Wittgenstein contends that meaning is use.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com According to: “W says meaning is use.”
rewrite.answer: According to Wittgenstein, meaning is use.
